name: txst-study-hub
description: Course-centered study matching for Texas State students.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:up && npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:server && npm run typecheck:client
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
